title: Otto III
fact_summary: The emperor in whose time, according to Thietmar of Merseburg, the Hungarian ruler Waic received his crown.

claims.text: Thietmar dates an event of 992 by “the reign of the third Otto”.
claims.certainty_reason: This records what the source says. The passage was read in Latin in the scanned edition linked under Sources; the English is Claude's own rendering.

claims.text: In the next chapter he says Waic received a crown and blessing “by the favour and urging of the aforesaid emperor”, and goes on to tell of a wonder at Rome “in the times of the aforesaid Caesar”.
claims.certainty_reason: Read in Latin. That “the aforesaid emperor” is Otto III is Claude's reading of the surrounding chapters; the sentence does not name him.

open_questions.text: When did Otto III become emperor, and when did he die? No source for his dates has been read yet.

review.note: Checked by Claude against open copies of every source. Marc spot-checks a sample.
